body.statement: For every admissible compact family \(\mathcal K\), \(\sup_{Q\in\mathcal K}P_{N,Q}\{\mathbb P_{N,Q}\notin\mathcal U_{\mathrm{rr}}\}\to0\), and \[\sup_{Q\in\mathcal K}d_{\mathrm{BL}}\!\left(\mathcal L_{P_{N,Q}}\!\left(\sqrt N\{[M_N]_Q-[M_T]_Q\},\sqrt N\{[\widehat P_{0X}]_Q-P_{0X,Q}\}\right),\mathcal L\{[\mathbb Z_T^{\mathrm{full}}]_Q\}\right)\to0\] in \(\mathbb R^{\dim(M_T)}\times\ell^\infty(\mathcal F_{0X,T})\). At each \(Q\), the covariance is the single bilinear formula defining \([\mathbb Z_T^{\mathrm{full}}]_Q\); hence \(\operatorname{Var}([Z_M]_Q)=[\Gamma_T]_Q\), including every cross-covariance between the initial empirical-process block and the reused-matrix mean, energy, Gram, and score blocks.
body.justification: The joint fluctuation law is the missing inferential layer between state evolution and causal-path uncertainty.
body.gap: Shirani and Bayati establish first-order state evolution and consistency, while available AMP results do not give this aggregate covariance recursion.
body.consumer: Configured Causal-MP regressions can replace an independence-based sandwich matrix by \(\Gamma_T\).
